notfound: There's no page at this address. Go to Generate.
model.intro: AnkiNote needs an AI provider to write your cards. Gemini is recommended: one key writes the cards, draws the pictures and records the audio.
model.resetNote: Choosing a provider resets every part to its recommended model.
model.keyOptional: API key (if the service needs one)
model.keySaved: Saved key {hint}. Leave empty to keep it.
model.advanced: Set up each kind of content separately
model.advancedIntro: Mix providers (each with its own key), choose other models, or turn pictures and audio off. Anything you leave alone moves to the recommended model in new releases.
model.loadingModels: Loading the models this key can use…
model.fetchFailed: Couldn't load the model list. Check the key, or type a model id.
model.listedNote: Pictures and audio are checked against the provider's model list, so testing costs nothing.
model.changeLater: You can change models any time in Settings → Models.
model.textFailed: The main model has to work before you can continue.
model.err.auth: {name} didn't accept this key. Check that you copied all of it.
model.err.model_not_found: {name} doesn't offer {model} to this key. Choose another model in the section below.
model.err.quota: {name} says this key is out of quota or sending too many requests. Check billing on the provider's site, then test again.
model.err.timeout: The model didn't respond within 30 seconds. Select Test again to try once more.
model.err.unreachable: Couldn't reach {name}. Check the address and your network, then test again.
model.err.cannot_list: This service doesn't list its models, so the model couldn't be checked. It's saved as entered.
model.err.invalid: Something in {route} isn't filled in. Check the model and address.
model.err.server: The AnkiNote server didn't answer. Check that it's still running, then try again.
model.err.load: Couldn't load the provider list from the AnkiNote server. Reload the page to try again.
model.howTo.key: Sign in to Google AI Studio and create an API key.
model.howTo.keyOther: Sign in to {name} and create an API key.
model.howTo.billing: For pictures, turn on billing for the key's project in AI Studio. Gemini's free tier doesn't draw images; card text and audio work without billing.
model.howTo.noApis: There are no other APIs or permissions to enable: the key works as created.
model.howTo.freeLimits: On the free tier each model has a daily request limit, and a word card makes several audio clips. AI Studio shows the limits of the key's project.
model.plan.unsupported: Off: {name} can't do this. Set it up separately below.
model.mainUnused: Every part is set up separately below, so no key is needed here.
model.billingNote: Gemini draws pictures only with billing turned on. A free-tier key passes this check, but generating a picture will fail.
model.gtts.billing: Choose or create a Google Cloud project with billing turned on. Cloud Text-to-Speech needs it even within its free monthly allowance.
model.gtts.enable: Enable the Cloud Text-to-Speech API in that project.
model.gtts.key: Create an API key under Credentials and, under API restrictions, allow only the Cloud Text-to-Speech API.
model.gtts.notAiStudio: Your AI Studio key won't work here: it's limited to the Gemini API.
model.err.api_disabled: The project behind this {name} key hasn't enabled the API it needs. Enable it in the Google Cloud console, then test again.
model.err.key_restricted: This {name} key isn't allowed to call the API it needs. Use a key whose API restrictions allow it (an AI Studio key works only for Gemini), then test again.
model.err.billing: {name} needs billing turned on for the key's project to use {model}. Turn it on, then test again.
anki.intro: AnkiNote saves your cards into an Anki collection. Choose where that collection lives.
anki.builtin.text: For an always-on server or NAS: AnkiNote keeps its own copy of your collection and syncs it with AnkiWeb, so you can add cards from your phone while no Anki is open. The first sync downloads your whole collection.
anki.builtin.unavailable: Not available on this system: the Anki library has no build for it. Use Anki Desktop instead.
anki.builtin.second: Anki Desktop is running on this computer. Built-in Anki would keep a second copy of your collection: it downloads everything from AnkiWeb first, and the two copies can later force you to overwrite one with the other. Unless this computer is an always-on server, choose Anki Desktop.
anki.desktop.text: Cards go straight into Anki on this computer through the AnkiConnect add-on, and Anki syncs them as usual. Anki has to be open while you save cards.
anki.desktop.detected: Anki is open and AnkiConnect answers at
anki.desktop.missing: No answer from AnkiConnect yet; AnkiNote keeps checking at
anki.passwordNote: Your password is sent to AnkiWeb once, to log in. AnkiNote keeps only the login token AnkiWeb sends back.
anki.relogin: AnkiWeb no longer accepts the saved login. Log in again to keep syncing.
anki.managed: The AnkiWeb account {account} is set by this server's configuration.
anki.sync.full: Copying the collection. A large collection can take a few minutes; you can leave this page open.
anki.sync.choice: Syncing is paused until you choose which copy to keep.
anki.sync.credentials: AnkiWeb didn't accept the saved login.
anki.sync.backup: Couldn't back up AnkiNote's collection, so nothing was replaced. Check that the disk has free space, then choose again.
anki.sync.media: Cards are synced; pictures and audio haven't finished. AnkiNote keeps retrying by itself.
anki.sync.offline: Can't reach AnkiWeb right now. Saved cards are kept, and AnkiNote retries by itself.
anki.sync.offlineFirst: Can't reach AnkiWeb, so the first sync hasn't finished. AnkiNote retries by itself; cards can be saved once it's done.
anki.full.only.download: Your cards are on AnkiWeb and Built-in Anki is still empty, so AnkiNote downloads them. Nothing on AnkiWeb changes.
anki.full.only.upload: AnkiWeb has no cards yet, so AnkiNote uploads Built-in Anki's collection to start yours.
anki.full.both: Built-in Anki and AnkiWeb both have changes that Anki can't merge, so one copy has to replace the other. Keep the one you've been studying with.
anki.full.keepText.download: Downloads them. Built-in Anki's cards and review history are replaced.
anki.full.keepText.upload: Uploads them. AnkiWeb's cards and review history are replaced.
anki.full.backup: AnkiNote backs up Built-in Anki first. The copy on AnkiWeb isn't backed up.
anki.full.replace.download: Download and replace Built-in Anki's cards

languages.intro: Cards teach one language and explain it in another you already know. You can change both later in Settings.
languages.nativeNote: Meanings, translations and memory hints are written in it.
languages.targetNote: Words, example sentences and audio are in it.
languages.betaNote: {lang} is in beta: its cards haven't been checked by a native reader yet, so double-check them.

languages.hint.native: Choose the language you know best.
languages.err.same_language: That's the language you know best. Choose another language to learn.

appearance.intro: Choose the colours AnkiNote uses. The app changes as you pick, and you can switch any time from the top bar.
appearance.system: Your system is in {mode} mode right now.
appearance.skipNote: Skip keeps the colours you had before this step.
appearance.why.kanagawa: From Hokusai's The Great Wave off Kanagawa.
appearance.why.gruvbox: Warm retro tones, easy on the eyes.
appearance.why.rose-pine: Muted pine and rosé for a quiet, minimal look.
appearance.cardsToo: Your Anki cards get this palette too, in light and night mode. You can give them their own later in Note types → Card theme.
appearance.cardsSeparate: Cards in Anki have their own palette:
appearance.cardsError: Couldn't save the card colours. Try Next again, or Skip and set them later in Note types → Card theme.
first.intro: Make one card to see what AnkiNote does. Try the suggested word or type your own, check the preview, then save it to Anki.
first.patience: Text comes first, then audio and a picture. It usually takes 20–60 seconds.
first.previewEmpty: The card's preview shows up here.
first.where: Goes to the {deck} deck as an “{type}” note.

sync.pending: Syncing with AnkiWeb in the background.
sync.error: Saved here, but syncing with AnkiWeb didn't finish. AnkiNote tries again on its own.
first.hint: Save this card to finish setup.

first.gen.auth: The main model's provider didn't accept the key. Check it in step 1.

first.gen.model_not_found: The provider doesn't offer the main model to this key. Choose another model in step 1.
first.gen.api_disabled: The key's Google project hasn't enabled the API it needs. Enable it in the Google Cloud console, then try again.
first.gen.key_restricted: The main model's key isn't allowed to call this API. Check the key's API restrictions, or use another key in step 1.
first.gen.unreachable: Couldn't reach the model's provider. Check your network, then try again.

first.save.unreachable: Anki Desktop isn't answering. Open Anki, then select Save to Anki again.
first.save.not_open: Anki isn't connected. Go back to Connect Anki.
first.save.draft_gone: This preview is gone because the AnkiNote server restarted. Select Generate again.
first.save.server: The AnkiNote server didn't answer. Check that it's still running, then select Save to Anki again.

edit.title: Edit — {text}
edit.intro: Changes apply to this card only. A changed example sentence gets new audio; the word itself can't be changed here — generate it again instead.
edit.applying: Applying… changed sentences get new audio, which can take a few seconds.
edit.where: Nothing reaches Anki until you save.
edit.err.blankRow: Every {field} row needs all its parts filled in, or remove the row.
edit.err.too_long: {field} is too long for a card.
edit.err.audio_not_set_up: A changed sentence needs new audio, but no speech model is set up. Add one in Settings → Models, or keep the sentence as it was.
edit.err.audio_failed: Couldn't make audio for the changed sentence ({detail}). Nothing was changed; select Apply to try again.
edit.err.timeout: Making the new audio took too long and was stopped. Select Apply to try again.
edit.err.draft_gone: This preview is gone because the AnkiNote server restarted. Select Cancel, then Regenerate.
edit.err.server: The AnkiNote server didn't answer. Check that it's still running, then select Apply again.
generate.placeholder.stem: Type a question or topic, e.g. What is a derivative? Or paste or drop a picture of it.
generate.picture.label: Picture
generate.picture.noVision: The main model can't read pictures. Switch to one that can, or type the question instead.
generate.picture.err.type: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP pictures work.
generate.picture.err.big: The picture is still too large after shrinking (the limit is 5 MB).
generate.err.no_vision: The main model didn't accept the picture; it may not be able to read pictures. Switch to another, or type the question instead.
generate.stemTypeHint: Auto lets the model pick the type that fits.
generate.diagramHint: Drawn only when a diagram helps.
generate.patience.stem: Generating the card. It usually takes 30–90 seconds.
generate.patience.wordImage: Text comes first, then a picture. It usually takes 20–60 seconds.
generate.patience.text: Writing the card. It usually takes 10–30 seconds.
rewrite.label: Rewrite with AI
rewrite.placeholder: What to change: simpler, add an example, the formula is wrong…
rewrite.hint: The whole card is replaced; Undo brings it back.
rewrite.err.blank: Say what to change, or pick another type.
edit.introStem: Changes apply to this card only, and the preview follows as you type. Write math between \( \) in a sentence or \[ \] on its own line; the formula field takes plain LaTeX. The diagram stays as it is; rewrite the card to get a new one.
edit.livePaused: Preview shows your last edit that could be shown: {error}
preview.mathErr: MathJax can't show these formulas, and Anki won't either:
preview.mathUnclosed: not closed: check that every { has its }, and that the formula ends with \) or \]
fix.hint: Only these formulas change; Undo brings the card back.
fix.live: Fix them in the form, or apply the edit and use Fix with AI.
model.textFailedSave: The main model has to work before you can save.
languages.introSettings: Cards teach one language and explain it in another you already know. New cards use the pair saved here; cards already in Anki stay as they are.
appearance.browserNote: Colours are kept in this browser; other devices keep their own.
notetypes.summary.ok: All up to date in Anki.
notetypes.change.templates: Adds cards: {names}. Each existing note gets them too.
notetypes.change.renamed: Renames the cards to {names}, in your native language. Cards and review history stay.
notetypes.change.css: Updates the styling: every card of this type changes look.
notetypes.createNote: Also creates the deck {deck} if it's missing.
notetypes.safe: Existing notes, cards and review history are kept.
notetypes.unknown: Connect Anki to see whether this note type is set up.
notetypes.sampleNote: A made-up note in this note type's real templates and styling. It isn't saved to your Anki.
notetypes.ankiEdit: Need something else? Edit the note type in Anki; AnkiNote only adds what's missing and restyles.

notetypes.err.write_blocked: Anki isn't ready for changes yet: the AnkiWeb sync hasn't finished.
notetypes.err.unreachable: Nothing answered at {url}. Open Anki Desktop with AnkiConnect installed, then check again.
cardtheme.title: Card theme
cardtheme.intro: One look for every AnkiNote card. Anki shows the light palette by day and the dark one in night mode, on every device.
cardtheme.applyNote: Restyles every AnkiNote card in Anki. Notes, cards and review history are kept, and other devices change after a normal sync.
cardtheme.unchanged: These are the colours your cards use now.
cardtheme.done: Applied. {n} note types in Anki have the new look.
cardtheme.doneNone: Saved. Note types you create from now on get this look.
cardtheme.savedOnly: Saved, but Anki couldn't be restyled: {reason} Your cards keep their current look until you update the note types.
cardtheme.err.load: Couldn't load the card theme from the AnkiNote server. Reload the page to try again.
cardtheme.err.save: Couldn't save the card theme. Try again; if it keeps happening, check the server log.
anki.sync.upgrade: Syncing is paused until the updated note types are uploaded.
anki.full.upgrade: AnkiNote added fields to its note types. Anki can't merge that kind of change, so Built-in Anki has to replace the copy on AnkiWeb, review history included. If another device has reviews that haven't reached AnkiWeb yet, sync it first.
anki.hint.choice: Choose which copy to keep to continue.
